tools.name: start_launch_inspection
tools.description: Run automated checks on a live website or web app to detect potential legal, accessibility, privacy, consumer law, security, SEO and speed issues. Use when the user is about to launch, publish or deploy a site, or asks if it is legal, compliant, accessible or ready to go live. Returns an inspection

tools.name: get_launch_inspection
tools.description: Get the status and results of a launch inspection. Waits up to about 25 seconds for a running inspection; if it is still running, call again. When done, returns the launch status (Not launch ready / Ready, with fixes to schedule / Passed), each finding with its severity, where it is, why it matters

tools.name: explain_launch_check
tools.description: Explain one Xaminat check by its number (for example "6.1" or "15.7"), or list a whole section (for example "15"), with what passing looks like. Use to explain a finding or to plan fixes.

tools.name: verify_site
tools.description: Prove the user owns a website so Xaminat can run the full inspection, including security checks and leaked-key details, and give a shareable "passed these checks" link. Call with action "start" to get a code and three ways to publish it (meta tag, file or DNS record), help the user publish it, then

tools.name: list_business_types
tools.description: List the business types Xaminat judges sites by (a hairdresser is checked differently from a consultancy or a health clinic), with each one's focus areas and extra checks. Use to pick business_type for an inspection.
